name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A set of rules and habits you install into an AI coding assistant so it writes software the disciplined way a senior engineer would, instead of freelancing.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small startup who is letting AI write real production code but is worried about quality drifting without a human reviewing every line.
business_use_cases: A dev shop standardizes every client project on this methodology so AI-written code is consistently reviewable and maintainable, a selling point in client pitches.
A solo founder uses it to keep their AI-built MVP from turning into unmaintainable spaghetti before they can afford a real engineering hire.
A coding bootcamp or course teaches it as the 'right way' to work with AI coding tools, a differentiator from courses that just teach prompting.

money_ideas.idea: Paid workshops or courses teaching teams how to adopt the methodology
A consulting retainer helping dev shops roll it out across their AI-assisted projects

steal_this: Install it on your own current AI-assisted project this weekend, document the before/after in commit quality, and turn that into a case study you can sell to other teams.
